edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given the rwb-partner contract mock does not answer inside 2 s
    When its trigger arrives
    Then nothing is written and no case move is answered
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC7 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the legal action "LA-2026-000805" carries the status "CLOSED"
    When the action is taken
    Then the action is refused with 409 and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC8 A component or a test reads a forbidden table or view
    Given a component or a test reads a partner or partner_instruction row, a recovery_case row, a v_ace_* view or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the read and the build fails

  Scenario: AC9 The business rules BR1 to BR9 hold
    Given the rules BR1 to BR9 of section 8 are in force
    When the boundary test runs
    Then each rule is verified by its test case of section 16 or by a guardrail test

  Scenario: AC10 The provided operations answer 401, 403 and 404
    Given the request carries no valid credential
    When the request is made
    Then the operation answers 401 and nothing is written
    Then a role without the Litigation right is answered 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing changes
    Then an action that does not exist or is outside the scope is answered 404 and nothing is written
